name: vibewatch
tagline: Tactile M5Stack stopwatch controller for AI-assisted vibe coding
description: vibewatch is a tactile M5Stack-based stopwatch controller built for AI-assisted vibe coding sessions. It puts a physical timer in your hands during agentic coding — start, stop, and pace your sessions with hardware instead of a tab. A unique hardware-software crossover that treats timeboxing as a physical practice.
highlights: Tactile M5Stack stopwatch for AI-assisted coding sessions
Physical timeboxing instead of a browser tab
C++ firmware on accessible M5Stack hardware
curatorNote: Vibe coding is all about flow, and flow needs timeboxes. A physical stopwatch on your desk is a delightful, low-tech answer to a very 2026 problem.
